title: Verify: App mounts PhaserHost once with BootScene and cleans up
summary: Unit tests with createGame and BootScene mocked prove the host replaces the flat image.
description: Write tests/appPhaserHost.test.tsx and migrate existing App-rendering tests so they mock Phaser.
acceptance_criteria: Given Begin is clicked, when App renders, then phaser-host exists and no scene image exists.
Given the App re-renders and unmounts, when createGame calls are counted, then it was called once and destroy(true) once.

in_scope: mock updates in existing App-rendering tests
preserve: Existing assertions on dialogue, history, inventory and header

technical_constraints: Never create a real Phaser game; mock ../src/phaser/createGame and ../src/phaser/BootScene
definition_of_done: Existing App tests pass with mocks and with Bookshelf selection driven via phaserToReact.emit('objectClick')

steps.action: Create a test file that vi.mock's '../src/phaser/createGame' (returning a fake {destroy, scale:{setZoom, refresh}}) and '../src/phaser/BootScene' (exporting class BootScene {}), stubs ResizeObserver, renders <App/>, clicks Begin, and adds tests: (1) getByTestId('phaser-host') exists and queryByRole('img') is null; (2) createGame mock called once and its second argument contains BootScene; (3) after rerender, still one call; after unmount destroy called once with true.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appPhaserHost.test.tsx tests/app.test.tsx tests/appFlow.test.tsx tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx tests/appHeader.test.tsx tests/appNoLegacyHeader.test.tsx tests/appRound.test.tsx tests/secretDoorPersistence.test.tsx
steps.expected: Three tests pass asserting host presence, BootScene passing, and single create/destroy.

steps.symbol: App tests (also appFlow, appContributionFocus, appHeader, appNoLegacyHeader, appRound, secretDoorPersistence)
steps.action: In each of these seven files add the same vi.mock for createGame and BootScene plus a ResizeObserver stub, and replace getByRole('button',{name:'Bookshelf'}) / 'Bedroom' img assertions with act(() => phaserToReact.emit('objectClick',{id:'bookshelf'})) and ActionMenu assertions; drop data-open hotspot assertions in favor of history text.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appPhaserHost.test.tsx tests/app.test.tsx tests/appFlow.test.tsx tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx tests/appHeader.test.tsx tests/appNoLegacyHeader.test.tsx tests/appRound.test.tsx tests/secretDoorPersistence.test.tsx
steps.expected: All seven files run without creating real Phaser and keep their non-scene assertions green.

steps.action: Run the new file and the seven migrated files only.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appPhaserHost.test.tsx tests/app.test.tsx tests/appFlow.test.tsx tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx tests/appHeader.test.tsx tests/appNoLegacyHeader.test.tsx tests/appRound.test.tsx tests/secretDoorPersistence.test.tsx
